description: Measure how many sentences two pages share word for word, using the text a crawler sees with JavaScript off (navigation and footers excluded). Sentences split on 。！？ and on . ! ? followed by whitespace; sentences under ten characters are ignored. The share is measured in characters, in both directions, and the larger figure decides, because a short page copied into a long one is a small share of the long page and all of the short one.

html_a.description: Rendered HTML of the first page.

html_b.description: Rendered HTML of the second page.

name: compare_pages
